calculators.formula_explanation: Net Taxable Income = Gross Annual Salary - Personal Exemptions (NT$97,000 per person, NT$145,500 for age 70+) - Standard Deduction (Single NT$131,000 / Married NT$262,000) - Special Deduction for Salary Income (capped at NT$218,000 or actual salary) - Tax-exempt Voluntary Pension (up to 6% of insured monthly salary limit * 12). Progressive Tax Brackets: 0–590,000: 5%; 590,001–1,330,000: 12% (progressive diff 41,300); 1,330,001–2,660,000: 20% (progressive diff 147,700); 2,660,001–4,980,000: 30% (progressive diff 413,700); >4,980,000: 40% (progressive diff 911,700). Monthly insurance: Labor Insurance = Insured wage * 11.5% * 20% (employee); NHI = Insured wage * 5.17% * 30% * (1 + qualifying dependents count, max 3).

calculators.formula_explanation: Net Gain = Sale Price - Purchase Price - Necessary Expenses (actual receipts or default 3% of sale price capped at NT$300,000) - Land Value Incremental Difference. If Self-Occupied 6+ Years: Taxable Gain = Max(0, Net Gain - 4,000,000 NTD); Tax Rate = 10%. Otherwise, Tax Rate based on Holding Period: <= 2 Years: 45%; > 2 to 5 Years: 35%; > 5 to 10 Years: 20%; > 10 Years: 15%. Tax Payable = Taxable Gain * Tax Rate. Additional closing fees: Deed Tax (契稅 = Evaluated House Value * 6%), Broker Commission (buyers up to 2%, sellers up to 4%).

calculators.formula_explanation: For Code 50 (Part-time Salary): Withholding Tax = 5% if single payment >= NT$88,501; 2nd Gen NHI Supplementary Premium = 2.11% if single payment >= NT$27,470 (minimum monthly wage limit). For Code 9A/9B (Professional Services / Royalties): Withholding Tax = 10% if single payment > NT$20,000; 2nd Gen NHI = 2.11% if single payment >= NT$20,000 (exempt if insured via professional guild). Code 9B enjoys an annual tax-free quota of NT$180,000 when filing May annual return. Net Amount Paid = Gross Amount - Withholding Tax Amount - 2nd Gen NHI Premium Amount.

calculators.formula_explanation: Taxable Corporate Profit = Annual Revenue - Operating Expenses/Costs. Corporate Income Tax (營所稅): Profit <= NT$120,000: Tax Rate = 0%; Profit between NT$120,001 and NT$200,000: Tax = (Profit - 120,000) * 50%; Profit > NT$200,000: Tax = Profit * 20%. Employer Monthly Statutory Labor Costs per employee: Employer Labor Insurance = Insured Wage * 11.5% * 70%; Employer Employment Insurance = Insured Wage * 1.0% * 70%; Employer Health Insurance = Insured Wage * 5.17% * 60% * 1.57 (average dependents factor); Mandatory Labor Pension = Insured Wage * 6%. Total Annual Employer Overhead = Monthly Cost * Employee Count * 12.

calculators.formula_explanation: Hourly Wage Rate = Monthly Regular Salary / 240 hours. Overtime Pay: Weekdays: First 2 hours = Hours * Hourly Wage * 1.34 (4/3); 3rd-4th hours = Hours * Hourly Wage * 1.67 (5/3). Rest Days: First 2 hours = 1.34; 3rd-8th hours = 1.67; 9th-12th hours = 2.67. National Holidays: First 8 hours = Hourly Wage * 8 (double pay). Severance Pay (Labor Pension New System): Total Seniority Years = tenure_years + (tenure_months / 12). Severance Amount = Min(6.0 months, 0.5 * Seniority Years) * Average Monthly Salary.
